primary.entity: baton / thin stick held by the Suited man
primary.what: The thin wooden stick (black-tipped baton or pencil) held in the Suited man's right hand at the right edge in f0 stays hanging at the same spot in f1-f2 (and again in f4) after he has turned and lowered his arms, with no hand or visible support holding it.

secondary.what: In Shot2 he wears a white wing collar with a loose white ascot/cravat and no dark tie; in Shot3 the same tuxedo has a dark long necktie and a white pocket square.
In Shot1 he wears a plain black notch-lapel suit with an open-collar white shirt and no tie, while Shot2/Shot3 show a tuxedo with maroon-brown satin peak lapels.

unspecified_seen: Exit signs (green in Shot1, lit sign top right in Shot3); audience seating rows (Shot1 right side, Shot3 background); balcony railing (Shot1); lamps mounted on music stands (gold glows in Shot2, black bar lamp in Shot3); a baton/stick (Shot3 only); a blurred pinkish shape at the right edge of Shot2 f1-f3 (possibly a person's head or a lamp, too blurred to judge); a pole-mounted light/clamp and a red-edged stand behind the man in Shot4 (Shot4 only). Exit signs, seating and stand lamps recur across shots without a visible change.
